component: IMAP test teardown reset and completion

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This later attempt closes cached connections before resetTest and removes performTest from teardown. The receiver sets the test marker true during reset; performTest would spin until that marker clears and a reader exists. stop remains an asynchronous call that the test does not await, followed by the already studied pending-thread drain. The patch therefore changes the teardown wait sequence without directly asserting final promise settlement or proving the reported timeout cured.
title: The later noselect teardown drops the server-test wait after connection closure
